summary.short: CMF Norma de Carácter General N° 514 (2024) sets operating rules for Chile's Open Finance System under Title III of Fintec Law 21.521: registration of information and payment initiation providers, mandatory APIs, security, consent, and phased deadlines for financial institutions.
summary.long: CMF Norma de Carácter General N° 514 (3 July 2024) sets rules for the Open Finance System (SFA) under Title III of Fintec Law No. 21.521. It covers financial information providers (IPI), account providers (IPC), information-based service providers (PSBI) and payment initiation providers (PSIP). PSBI registration is voluntary. PSIP registration is mandatory for entities already providing initiation services, within twelve months. PSIP applicants must post a guarantee tied to average daily amounts, with a UF 1.000 base. Temporary fund custody, where permitted, is capped at 72 hours. IPI and IPC must offer APIs meeting listed standards, with availability and response-time minimums, plus an alternative mechanism. The norm sets consent and dashboard requirements, five-year record-keeping, security and incident-reporting duties, and call-volume thresholds for reimbursable costs. The CMF may suspend participants and apply sanctions under Title III of DL 3.538. Deadlines are staged, from 6 to 36 months depending on participant group.

notes: Target instrument IDs are left empty because the registry IDs are not given in the document. Annexes 3 and 4 are marked “Por definir” and contain no text. Internal cross-reference error: the consent rules (Sección III.D.1 letra b) refer to “sección III.E.2”, but consent management is in Sección III.D.2. Timing: Sección V.C counts the 24-month first implementation stage from publication of the norm, while Sección V.E says entry into force is 24 months from its issuance (dictación); the text does not reconcile these anchors. The PSIP registration deadline (Sección I.D.5) runs 12 months from entry into force. Spot-check (Opus, 2026-10-14): implementation milestones counted from entry into force (Sección V.C, I.D.5, I.E.2, II.A.3) were left without dates: entry into force is computed from the issue date under Sección V.E, but Sección V.C counts the same 24 months from publication, which the text does not date. private_right_of_action is null in all enforcement rows: the norm neither creates nor excludes one.

evidence.quote: El PSIP no podrá mantener o custodiar los fondos del cliente ordenante o pagador, salvo acreditación previa ante la CMF

obligations.summary: PSIPs must refrain from requesting from paying clients more information or data than strictly necessary to initiate the payment order, without prejudice to anti-money laundering and terrorist financing duties.

evidence.quote: Los PSIP deberán abstenerse de solicitar a los clientes ordenantes o pagadores más información o datos de los estrictamente necesarios

obligations.summary: PSIPs must adopt technical and organisational measures to comply with the limitation on use of personal data in Article 20 of the Fintec Law; a PSIP also registered as PSBI may, with client consent, combine payment initiation data with other information for financial review, reconciliation services.

evidence.quote: Los PSIP deberán adoptar las medidas técnicas y organizativas necesarias para dar cumplimiento efectivo a la limitación de uso de datos personales

obligations.summary: A PSIP must report any change to the information provided in its application within five business days of the event or of becoming aware of it; registry-nature changes also require a registry annotation request and payment of fees.
obligations.applies_from: From the date of the application while registered
obligations.conditional_on: While registered in the PSIP Registry

evidence.quote: dentro del plazo de cinco días hábiles de ocurrido el hecho respectivo

obligations.summary: On cancellation or CMF-ordered termination, the PSIP must prepare and report a detailed plan ensuring no pending transactions or claims with payees remain, inform clients, and refrain from providing payment initiation services without a valid registration.
obligations.applies_from: At the date the cancellation takes effect
obligations.conditional_on: Cancellation of PSIP registration

evidence.quote: deberá disponer e informar a la Comisión de un plan detallado que garantice y acredite que no existan transacciones

obligations.summary: Incorporation into the IPI and IPC lists is mandatory for entities that the Fintec Law requires to participate in the SFA; it requires disclosure to the Directory of Participants, compliance with interface standards, testing, ARC documentation, a security profile certificate and risk management policies.
obligations.conditional_on: Entities that the Fintec Law designates as IPI or IPC

evidence.quote: La incorporación en esta nómina es obligatoria para las entidades que la Ley Fintec haya definido que deben ser parte del SFA

obligations.summary: For list incorporation, IPI and IPC must obtain a functional testing report and certification of results from a provider of recognised standing, including contingency scenarios, with an unqualified opinion, under the requirements of Annex N°3.
obligations.conditional_on: Incorporation into the IPI or IPC list

evidence.quote: Evidenciar a través de la emisión de un reporte de hallazgos y de certificación de resultados

obligations.summary: IPI and IPC must demonstrate to the CMF the adoption and implementation of the risk management policies in Section III; entities with existing risk policies must supplement them with SFA-specific aspects.
obligations.conditional_on: Incorporation into the IPI or IPC list

evidence.quote: Acreditar ante la Comisión la adopción e implementación de las políticas de gestión de riesgo

obligations.summary: IPIs under Article 18 first subparagraph and IPCs under Article 20 must file their list application within the first 90 days after entry into force; IPIs under Article 18 second subparagraph (a) to (h) have 18 months.
obligations.applies_from: Within the first 90 days after entry into force of this norm (IPI first subparagraph and IPC); 18 months after entry into force (other IPI)
obligations.conditional_on: Entities designated as IPI or IPC by the Fintec Law

evidence.quote: Deberán presentar su solicitud dentro de los primeros 90 días de entrada en vigencia de la presente Norma

obligations.summary: Entities registered as PSBI through the list of financial service providers must request inclusion in the PSBI list and demonstrate compliance with the PSBI requirements.
obligations.conditional_on: Voluntary participation as PSBI by IPIs or registered financial service providers

evidence.quote: deberán solicitar su incorporación y acreditar ante la Comisión el cumplimiento de los requisitos dispuestos para los PSBI

obligations.summary: IPIs and IPCs must make APIs available for the SFA, together with the associated technical documentation, to serve data access requests from PSBIs and PSIPs.

evidence.quote: Las IPI e IPC deberán poner a disposición APIs para el SFA

obligations.summary: Supervised entities may not use mechanisms other than APIs to respond to data access requests, subject to any alternative mechanism regulated by the CMF.

evidence.quote: las entidades fiscalizadas no podrán utilizar mecanismos diferentes a las API para atender solicitudes de acceso a datos

obligations.summary: Compliance with the API standards in Table N°1 (OpenAPI 3.1, JSON, RESTful, ISO 20022, OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect, FAPI 2.0, mTLS) must be demonstrated by a report from an independent third party sent to the CMF; new interface versions should remain backward compatible where technically feasible.

evidence.quote: El cumplimiento de estos estándares deberá ser acreditado mediante informe emanado de un tercero independiente y remitido a la Comisión

obligations.summary: Data APIs for information categories in Article 17 numerals 1 to 3 must have minimum availability of 95% daily and 99% monthly and process transactions within 4,000 milliseconds; payment initiation APIs must have minimum availability of 95% daily and 99.5% monthly and process within 800 milliseconds; scheduled maintenance is excluded from the availability calculation.

evidence.quote: deben estar disponibles para su uso con un tiempo de actividad mínimo del 95% de forma diaria por día calendario

obligations.summary: Availability and performance reports must be sent to the CMF monthly, on a weekly basis, in the formats the CMF determines; outsourcing of monitoring does not remove the entity's responsibility for complete and timely reporting.

evidence.quote: los reportes a la CMF de los respectivos estándares se deberán enviar mensualmente en base semanal

obligations.summary: IPIs and IPCs must maintain an alternative information delivery mechanism to operate when the principal interfaces are unavailable, meeting the technical requirements in Annex N°3 and uniform for all participants.
obligations.conditional_on: Unavailability of principal interfaces

evidence.quote: Las IPI e IPC deberán contar con un mecanismo alternativo de entrega de información

obligations.summary: Each participant is solely responsible for verifying that its own information in the Directory of Participants is correct and has not undergone substantive changes; participants must supply contact, certificate and endpoint information to the Directory.

evidence.quote: Será obligación y responsabilidad exclusiva de cada participante el cerciorarse que la información sobre sí mismo contenida en el DP resulte correcta

obligations.summary: IPIs and IPCs must carry out periodic random data quality tests at least every six months, including comparability analysis and error source analysis, and report results to the CMF.

evidence.quote: Las pruebas serán realizadas al menos con periodicidad semestral y sus resultados serán entregados a la Comisión

obligations.summary: IPIs and IPCs must inform the CMF as soon as they become aware of any significant deficiency in the information transmitted through their SFA interfaces, through the operational incident reporting channels.
obligations.conditional_on: Awareness of a significant deficiency in transmitted information

evidence.quote: las IPI e IPC deberán informar a la Comisión tan pronto tomen conocimiento de su existencia, toda deficiencia significativa en la información

obligations.summary: IPIs and IPCs must have processes to handle and resolve API problems affecting other participants, with clear error messages, and must designate a responsible officer (name, position, email and telephone) for communication with participants and the CMF.

evidence.quote: Las entidades deben designar un funcionario responsable a quien contactar

obligations.summary: The board or equivalent body must approve and authorise risk management and internal control policies at least once a year, set strategic objectives, approve risk policies, assess resources and organisation, and evaluate a risk committee.

evidence.quote: es la instancia responsable de aprobar y autorizar las políticas de gestión de riesgos y control interno, como mínimo una vez al año

obligations.summary: The risk management function must monitor controls, report directly to the board or equivalent body, report breaches with causes and measures, propose policy changes, and prepare an annual plan; the board must segregate and keep this function independent of business areas.

evidence.quote: Esta función deberá reportar directamente al directorio u órgano equivalente.

obligations.summary: The risk management function must prepare a risk management plan covering at least business continuity, information security and cybersecurity risks, with mitigation strategies, contingency planning, control mechanisms and continuous improvement, approved by the board at least annually.

evidence.quote: El plan deberá contemplar, a lo menos, los riesgos de continuidad operacional, seguridad de la información y ciberseguridad.

obligations.summary: Operational risk management must give reasonable assurance of protecting client information, set risk appetite levels approved by the board, and define key risk indicators, adapted to business model, volume and client types.

evidence.quote: los Participantes del SFA deberán considerar los elementos que se señalan a continuación

obligations.summary: Services provided by third-party suppliers relevant to compliance, continuity, security and service quality must be included in operational risk processes, considering substitution, intervention, subcontracting and concentration risks.
obligations.conditional_on: Outsourcing to suppliers

evidence.quote: deberán ser considerados en los procesos de gestión de riesgo operacional de la entidad

obligations.summary: Operational risk management must include information security and cybersecurity elements: policies and procedures, ICT policies, qualified staff, roles and responsibilities, revocation of access on staff changes, audits, and board reporting.

evidence.quote: la gestión de riesgo operacional deberá incluir los siguientes elementos, aplicables a todas las entidades participantes del SFA

obligations.summary: Entities must implement information security procedures covering asset inventories and classification, physical and logical access controls, monitoring of privileged users, mobile and remote access, backups, cloud services, authentication for digital channels, and a high-level incident management body with response and recovery procedures updated at least annually.

evidence.quote: La entidad deberá considerar los siguientes procedimientos, adaptados a su modelo de negocios

obligations.summary: Participants must report operational incidents affecting business continuity, information, client service quality, cyberattacks, malware, data leaks or fraud losses to the CMF; the CMF may require an internal report on causes and measures; a responsible officer and alternate must be designated.
obligations.conditional_on: Occurrence of an operational incident

evidence.quote: Los actores del SFA deberán comunicar a esta Comisión los incidentes operacionales

obligations.summary: Cybersecurity incidents must be reported to the CMF through the Operational Incident Report (RIO) platform within a maximum of 30 minutes from the entity becoming aware of the event, with an initial report and a closing report including the listed fields.
obligations.conditional_on: Occurrence of an incident

evidence.quote: en el plazo máximo de 30 minutos transcurridos desde que la entidad tomó conocimiento del hecho

obligations.summary: Participants must have a business continuity policy covering response to internal or external events, responsibilities, and annual approval by the board or equivalent body, plus a crisis plan with escalation, communication and recovery objectives set in a business impact analysis.

evidence.quote: Contar con una política de continuidad de negocio que considere a lo menos lo siguiente

obligations.summary: Continuity and disaster recovery plans must be tested annually, supervised by the risk management function, based on plausible severe scenarios including cyberattacks, disasters and health crises, with results reported to the board.

evidence.quote: Pruebas anuales del Plan de Continuidad de Negocio y Recuperación de Desastres

obligations.summary: API security standards require monitoring of API data requests and responses, backups, keeping event logs for at least five years identifying requester, time, data transmitted and result, encryption according to sensitivity, deletion of data once legal retention limits expire, and contingency sites.

evidence.quote: Mantener registro de los eventos propios del SFA

obligations.summary: Entities must use the Open ID Connect standard, layered on OAuth 2.0, as described in Annex N°3 for the services and APIs there listed.

evidence.quote: Corresponderá utilizar, en lo que corresponda, el estándar Open ID Connect

obligations.summary: Strong client authentication (ARC) using two or more independent elements of knowledge, possession and inherence is required for data queries that involve client information subject to consent; after authenticating the PSBI or PSIP, IPIs and IPCs must authenticate the client, including authorisation and payment confirmation.
obligations.conditional_on: Data queries involving client information subject to consent

evidence.quote: Se requerirá una Autenticación Reforzada del Cliente -ARC- para la consulta de datos del SFA

obligations.summary: IPIs and IPCs must receive a digital certificate from the PSBI or PSIP issued by a certification authority meeting the Annex N°3 requirements, compare the certificate permissions and roles against the Directory of Participants, and confirm the validity of each PSBI and PSIP.

evidence.quote: Las IPI e IPC deberán recibir un Certificado Digital por parte del PSBI o PSIP

obligations.summary: Consent is deemed given only if expressed explicitly by the data subject or authorised representative, implemented through the consent management mechanism, stored on a durable medium, free of undue influence, limited to what is strictly necessary, given in plain language, and accompanied by a control panel; the detailed conditions are listed in letters a to i.
obligations.conditional_on: Data exchange, processing, transfer or payment initiation within the SFA

evidence.quote: se reputará otorgado el consentimiento por parte del titular de los datos

obligations.summary: When requesting consent, the entity must tell the data subject precisely which data, to which institution, for what period or frequency and purpose; the request may not contain other information or request consent for other purposes.
obligations.conditional_on: Requesting consent for transmission, processing, transfer or payment initiation

evidence.quote: se deberá poner en conocimiento del titular o cliente de manera precisa y clara los datos sobre los cuales consiente

obligations.summary: IPIs and IPCs may not alter the consent request formulated by the PSBI or PSIP, request additional consent for the same exchange, adopt practices that discourage consent, or degrade the user experience.

evidence.quote: Queda prohibido a la IPI o a la IPC alterar el contenido de la solicitud de consentimiento

obligations.summary: PSBIs, PSIPs, IPIs and IPCs must provide data subjects and clients a control panel to know, verify and revoke consents, free of charge, remote and easy to use, with authentication equivalent to Section III.C, showing details of each consent and its status, and with real-time communication of revocations.

evidence.quote: Las PSBI, PSIP, IPI e IPC deberán poner a disposición de los titulares de datos y clientes un panel de control

obligations.summary: A registration system must preserve, intact and for at least five years, the accesses and interactions of data subjects for CMF supervision, and display all consents granted, revoked or expired during the last five years.

evidence.quote: Contar con un sistema o mecanismo de registro que permita preservar, de manera íntegra y por al menos 5 años

obligations.summary: If a data subject does not access the control panel for more than one calendar year while valid consents exist, a reminder must be sent to the contact the subject has set within the first five business days after that year.
obligations.applies_from: Within the first five business days after one calendar year of inactivity
obligations.conditional_on: Inactivity of the data subject on the control panel with valid consents

evidence.quote: Dicha comunicación se deberá remitir dentro de los cinco primeros días hábiles inmediatamente posteriores

obligations.summary: SFA data must be available on client request, kept current and validated against client status, reflect changes and corrections, and be available equally via the principal and alternative mechanisms; for online balances all current products must be reported, with the date of last available information where updates are periodic.

evidence.quote: Los datos del SFA deberán cumplir con las siguientes condiciones

obligations.summary: Participants must at all times protect integrity, availability, security and confidentiality of data in each transaction and of client information, in consideration of the Fintec Law and Law 19.628.

evidence.quote: Los Participantes del SFA deberán, en todo momento, resguardar la integridad, disponibilidad, seguridad y confidencialidad de los datos

obligations.summary: Participants must adopt adequate procedures to channel and manage the exercise of data subject rights over data incorporated into SFA interfaces.

evidence.quote: Los Participantes deberán adoptar procedimientos adecuados para canalizar y gestionar el ejercicio de los derechos de los titulares de datos

obligations.summary: Client data shared through the SFA may be used by the PSBI or PSIP only for the specific purposes stated when consent was given, without prejudice to another legal basis for processing.

evidence.quote: Los datos autorizados a compartir por el Cliente solo pueden ser utilizados por el PSBI y/o por el PSIP

obligations.summary: A participant that considers a relevant risk to SFA information assets requiring urgent action must take immediate preventive measures, such as disconnection from the SFA, and send an immediate report to the CMF with the measures and grounds, then correct the situation and inform the CMF when resolved.
obligations.conditional_on: Relevant risk to SFA information assets requiring urgent action

evidence.quote: deberá enviar de inmediato un reporte a la CMF informando las medidas adoptadas

obligations.summary: Banks, card issuers and prepaid card issuers must implement APIs for Terms and Conditions and Channels of Attention within six months of the Norm entering into force.
obligations.applies_from: Six months after the Norm enters into force (after the 24-month preparation period)
obligations.conditional_on: Entity is a bank, credit card issuer or prepaid card issuer

evidence.quote: 6 meses para implementación de APIs sobre Términos y Condiciones Generales y de Canales de Atención

obligations.summary: Banks, card issuers and prepaid card issuers must implement APIs for Enrollment, Historical Financial Positions, Transaction History and Current Products for natural persons within 15 months (and credit lines within 18 months) and for legal persons within 18 months; Payment Initiation APIs within 18 months.
obligations.applies_from: Fifteen to eighteen months after the Norm enters into force
obligations.conditional_on: Entity is a bank, credit card issuer or prepaid card issuer

evidence.quote: 15 meses para implementación de APIs sobre Enrolamiento, Posiciones Financieras Históricas, Historial de usos y transacciones, y Productos vigentes

obligations.summary: Entities under Article 18 second subparagraph (a) to (h) of the Fintec Law must implement APIs for Terms and Conditions and Channels of Attention within 24 months of the Norm entering into force.
obligations.applies_from: 24 months after the Norm enters into force
obligations.conditional_on: Entities listed in Article 18 second subparagraph (a) to (h) of the Fintec Law

evidence.quote: 24 meses para implementación de APIs sobre Términos y Condiciones Generales y Canales de Atención

obligations.summary: Entities under Article 18 second subparagraph (a) to (h) of the Fintec Law must implement APIs for Enrollment, Historical Financial Positions, Transaction History and Current Products for all client types within 36 months of the Norm entering into force.
obligations.applies_from: 36 months after the Norm enters into force
obligations.conditional_on: Entities listed in Article 18 second subparagraph (a) to (h) of the Fintec Law

evidence.quote: 36 meses para implementación de APIs sobre Enrolamiento

obligations.summary: IPIs and IPCs may not discriminate against third-party data recipients, for example by prioritising some institutions over others in data extraction, development time, API access or response limits.

evidence.quote: Las IPI o IPC no pueden dar un trato discriminatorio a los terceros receptores de datos

obligations.summary: After certifying the identity of PSBIs or PSIPs, IPIs and IPCs must provide the authorised services according to user profiles without requiring an agreement between the parties; service conditions must be published.
obligations.conditional_on: After identity certification of the PSBI or PSIP

evidence.quote: deberá brindar los servicios respectivos autorizados al usuario de información según sus perfiles, sin necesidad de acuerdo entre las partes

obligations.summary: IPIs may not charge PSBIs, except the direct incremental costs of serving queries above the volume thresholds set by the CMF; IPCs may not charge clients or PSIPs beyond what is agreed for the account, as stated in the Fintec Law.
obligations.conditional_on: Volume thresholds set by the CMF exceeded

evidence.quote: De la misma forma, las IPI no podrán efectuar cobros o realizar cargos a los PSBI

obligations.summary: Any change to tariff terms must be notified to participants at least 30 days before taking effect; each IPI must also inform PSBIs monthly of the effective consumption of its interfaces and the number of calls exceeding the charging threshold.
obligations.applies_from: At least 30 days before the tariff change takes effect
obligations.conditional_on: Tariff term changes and monthly reporting of consumption

evidence.quote: Cualquier modificación en los términos tarifarios deberá ser informada a los Participantes con al menos 30 días de anticipación

enforcement.triggered_by: Infracciones a la Ley Fintec (Ley N°21.521) o incumplimiento de las instrucciones de la Norma por los Participantes del SFA
enforcement.max_penalty_text: No maximum penalty stated in this text; the text refers to sanctions under Título III of DL N°3.538.
enforcement.penalty_reference: Título III del DL N°3.538, de 1980 (cross-reference in Sección V.B); art. 27 of Ley Fintec

evidence.quote: serán sancionados conforme a las reglas establecidas en el Título III del DL N°3.538, de 1980

enforcement.triggered_by: Deficiencias en la calidad de la información; incidentes de ciberseguridad o operacionales; deficiencias en la gestión de riesgos; otros inconvenientes con efecto negativo sobre el Sistema
enforcement.max_penalty_text: Temporary suspension (partial or total) of an entity's participation or its interfaces; no monetary amount stated.
enforcement.penalty_reference: Art. 27, inciso penúltimo, Ley Fintec (cited in Sección V.A)

evidence.quote: podrá suspender temporalmente, de forma parcial o total, la participación de las entidades o sus interfaces

enforcement.triggered_by: Infracciones a la Ley Fintec o al incumplimiento de las instrucciones de la Norma (suspensión definitiva o cancelación de registro)
enforcement.max_penalty_text: Definitive suspension or cancellation of registration; no monetary amount stated.
enforcement.penalty_reference: Sección V.B; see also Sección I.C.3 and Sección I.E (cancellation of registry entries for breach of Ley Fintec or this Norma)

evidence.quote: podrá sancionar con una suspensión definitiva o cancelación de registro
